items.quote: Peers observed that Tan Brenova headed cost savings across procurement, setting priorities for several teams.
Tan delivered his share of the settlement of a long-running contract dispute reliably.
Direct reports said that Tan took ownership of piloting new approaches to grant applications and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Tan Brenova contributed effectively to media interviews and press conferences.
He contributed effectively to customer feedback improvements at service centres.
